gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-lao: Noto Serif Lao reads bookish and authoritative, with tall lowercase forms and bowls that shift weight gently. Goldman stays wide and bold above it, and over a full page the body keeps its steady, dignified pull.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-makasar: Wide, bold, a bit stern. Noto Serif Makasar follows with towering lowercase and a soft slide from heavy to light, while Goldman earns its place when big and brief.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-malayalam: Refined is the first word for this pairing, and Goldman supplies the bold, wide-set punch of a display face. Noto Serif Malayalam does the quieter work, with generous counters and bowls that thin gently across the line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-np-hmong: Noto Serif NP Hmong reads literary, with a faint charcoal-like shadow in its strokes. Goldman's round, widely spaced forms stand apart from it, so a long run of text feels softly pressed and unhurried, never stiff.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-old-uyghur: Refined and literary, Noto Serif Old Uyghur shows tall, bulb-like bowls beneath Goldman's wide, commanding capitals. Give the heading more size than the text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-oriya: Goldman opens wide and bold, its round forms like open parentheses and its lowercase tall against the capitals. And Noto Serif Oriya follows with slightly heavier curves, giving the text a dignified, authoritative weight underneath.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-ottoman-siy: Wide, bold, unmistakably commanding. Noto Serif Ottoman Siyaq settles into a long passage with its sizable lowercase and bowls that swell only slightly, so the reading feels dignified and classic.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-sinhala: Goldman brings wide, bold, commanding letters with round forms like open parentheses, set generously apart. But Noto Serif Sinhala answers with a tall band of lowercase and stroke weights that differ just enough to feel alive.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-telugu: Bold and wide-set, with a commanding hush. Noto Serif Telugu brings the pair's strongest quality: a traditional, refined hand whose tall lowercase nearly reaches the capitals beneath Goldman.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-thai: Goldman's widely set, parenthesis-round letters give it a bold, commanding look at display size. Noto Serif Thai does its best work as the bookish text voice, with bodies that dominate the line and a mellow range of stroke weights.
